name: What are the most popular bathroom design trends that appeal to home buyers?

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular bathroom design trends that appeal to home buyers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current trends that appeal to home buyers include clean, modern aesthetics with neutral color palettes. Think bright, airy spaces with good lighting. Popular features include walk-in showers with frameless glass, freestanding tubs, dual vanities, and smart storage solutions. Buyers also appreciate durable, low-maintenance materials like quartz countertops and large-format porcelain tiles. Focus on creating a spa-like atmosphere that feels both luxurious and functional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular trends include clean, modern designs with neutral colors, walk-in showers, dual vanities, and durable materials like quartz.
